_comment: OpenCode Zen free models only (cost 0), the five that answered and passed the smoke on 2026-09-12 in under 25 s (nemotron-3.5-lightning and nemotron-3-ultra also pass but are slow). Rate limits are shared across projects: two free projects at once can end in NO_MODELS. Requires 'opencode' in enabled_providers and these ids in provider.opencode.whitelist. timeouts_seconds.silence: a model with no output at all in that many seconds is dropped at once (NO_RESPONSE), not remembered as a failure.
